first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that reducing signup friction and shortening onboarding improve early activation and time-to-value. This is more likely to produce sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing, which previously harmed 30-day retention. Verify the two most directly relevant records before committing.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification experiment only for simple SMB/self-serve accounts. The verified evidence shows improved activation, completion, time-to-value, and qualified revenue in this segment, while shortened onboarding increased churn in complex-workspace accounts. Exclude complex workspaces, monitor 30- and 60-day retention and qualified revenue, and stop or roll back if downstream value deteriorates.
